item.text: {"decision":"Approve the four existing proposed acquisition requests as immediately relevant and non-duplicative. The current board supports only the reported fall event from D01; D02 and D04 define applicable system/procedure limits, while D15 remains an unreviewed interpretation and is not adopted as mechanism evidence. No physical release mechanism or upstream cause is yet supported.","operations":[{"action":"revise","expected_version":1,"replaces":null,"reason":"Approved for evidence acquisition. D01.S03 reports that a motion record was retained, while D02.S04-S05 makes the requested time-position trace, relative withdrawal inputs, and interference timing directly material to whether primary seating engagement could have been lost and whether carrier/yoke relative travel was affected. This does not assume keeper bypass; remaining gaps after this request would include lateral-offset/dynamic-path evidence unless included in the motion source.
